# Sheriyakam

> Sheriyakam is Kerala's verified on-demand electrical, AC, CCTV, and home maintenance service platform. We connect residential and commercial customers with licensed, background-checked electricians and technicians across all 14 districts in Kerala.

## Core Capabilities & Key Facts
- **Rapid Emergency Dispatch**: 90-minute on-site response for power outages, short circuits, and critical electrical failures.
- **Government Licensed Professionals**: 100% verified wireman and supervisor licenses certified by the Kerala Electrical Inspectorate.
- **Transparent Pricing**: Upfront inspection tariffs starting from ₹350 with itemized rate cards before work begins.
- **Domestic Safety Protection**: Every booking includes up to ₹5,00,000 accidental damage protection cover.
- **Service Warranty**: 30-day rework guarantee on all completed installations and repairs.
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 emergency dispatch; 8:00 AM – 9:00 PM standard appointments.

## Primary Services & Pricing
- [Emergency Repair Specialist](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): 24/7 priority triage for short circuits, sparking, and blackout faults. Starting at ₹550.
- [Fan Repair & Installation](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Ceiling, exhaust, and BLDC fan installation and capacitor repairs. Starting at ₹350.
- [Complete Home & Office Wiring](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Concealed conduits, 3-phase load distribution, rewiring, and surge protection. Starting at ₹550.
- [Distribution Board (DB) & Switchgear](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): MCB/RCCB tripping diagnostics, breaker replacements, and DB overhaul. Starting at ₹450.
- [Inverter & UPS Setup](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Battery water top-up, backup load optimization, and inverter wiring. Starting at ₹500.
- [Air Conditioner (AC) Service & Repair](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): Jet wash cleaning, gas leakage refilling, capacitor replacements, and uninstallation. Starting at ₹650.
- [CCTV Security Camera Setup](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): IP/HD camera mounting, DVR/NVR configuration, and remote mobile viewing. Starting at ₹550.
- [Smart Home Automation](https://sheriyakam.vercel.app/): WiFi smart switches, automated lighting, and voice-controlled relays. Starting at ₹500.

## Geographic Coverage
Sheriyakam services all 14 districts across Kerala:
- Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Pathanamthitta, Alappuzha, Kottayam, Idukki, Ernakulam (Kochi), Thrissur, Palakkad, Malappuram, Kozhikode, Wayanad, Kannur, and Kasaragod.
